build_texture_from_render: build a texture map from a rendered view using a RenderLayer and camera extrinsics
create_view_texture: create a texture image and mask by projecting a view onto UV coordinates with barycentric weights
compute_geometry_texture: compute view texture from geometry, faces, and an image using index and barycentric images
render_and_extract_texture: render geometry with a RenderLayer then extract texture using compute_view_texture with normal threshold
review_get_tex_rl: review the get_tex_rl function that extracts texture from a single-view render using camera parameters
